label: Steampunk Workshop
description: Brass, pressure and craft: a working shop where every mechanism looks like it was built by someone who had to maintain it.
prefix: A steampunk workshop interior, every mechanism built by someone who has to maintain it
suffix: brass and blued steel with real wear at the touch points, riveted seams, pressure gauges and copper pipework routed the way a fitter would route it, oil and coal dust everywhere
negative: clean showroom finish, plastic parts, modern electronics, watermark, signature, text artifacts, deformed, extra limbs, extra fingers, child, underage, nsfw
